selection_basis: Inherited #21 windows and ordered-ID hashes; no score-driven selection
windows: Half-open target-label windows; training is 2011 calendar year before readiness exclusion
time_semantics: Naive source-calendar interval-start labels by convention, not verified UTC/timezone/DST or elapsed-hour semantics
readiness_qualification: Hypothetical immediate aggregate availability; train target t allowed only if t+1h <= first validation issuance. Not an operational source guarantee.
feature_policy: Only target calendar fields; no weather, season, holiday, workingday, raw IDs/date/year, targets/components, lags or interactions
fit_cadence: Once at first development issuance; frozen through validation
primary_metric: Mean binary log_loss, natural log, labels=[0,1], float64 probabilities; no penalty in evaluation
metric_clipping: sklearn 1.7.2 clips each probability to [float64 eps,1-eps], no post-clipping renormalization; preserve raw scores

policies.selection: Two fixed demonstrations, no winner or cost tuning

convergence: Any ConvergenceWarning blocks completion; never adapt C, iterations or labels
final_test: IDs/times metadata only; no labels, balance, fitting, predictions or scoring until later approved gate
prior_access: Inherited whole-source mechanical schema/domain/component checks read all count fields; final targets are not literally unseen
objective: mean binary cross entropy + sum(w**2)/(2*C*n_train); intercept unpenalized; no sample/class weights
representation_caveat: Reference coding breaks category symmetry for penalized models; unknown category uses zero reference block
